name: Sunrise Farmers' Market At Sunrise Mall
description: Sunrise Farmers' Market At Sunrise Mall grows Strawberries, Corn, Flowers, Honey, and Eggs in 6196 Sunrise Blvd., CA. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
